signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.description: Sign in with your account to continue.

unconfigured.title: No way in yet
unconfigured.description: This CRM has no sign-in method configured, so nobody can get in — including you.
unconfigured.help: Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET — or MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID and MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET — in the root .env file and restart. Your own identity provider can be added from Settings once somebody is signed in.

socialSignIn.error: Could not reach the sign-in service.

onboarding.title: Tell us about your company
onboarding.description: Two things, once. The name is what the CRM calls you; the website is how the agent learns what you sell.
onboarding.workspaceUrlDescription: Your team will use this address to open the CRM.
onboarding.websiteDescription: Read once, so every answer afterwards knows what you sell.

research.title: Level up your CRM data
research.description: Power your research agent with Context to research every company added to your CRM.
research.noKey: Don't have a Context API key?

grantAccess.title: One more step
grantAccess.descriptionGoogle: This CRM reads your Gmail and Calendar so meetings and email threads show up on the right company. It is read-only — nothing is ever sent on your behalf.
grantAccess.descriptionMicrosoft: This CRM reads your Outlook mail so email threads show up on the right company. It is read-only — nothing is ever sent on your behalf.
grantAccess.descriptionBoth: This CRM reads your mail and calendar so meetings and email threads show up on the right company. It is read-only — nothing is ever sent on your behalf.
grantAccess.privacyNote: Only conversations with companies in the CRM are stored. Personal mail is discarded without being saved.
